findings: Both independent first-public-context windows stop via original-context-settled (8206 ms and 7970 ms), not the 45 s fallback.

Both windows show repository critical paths from routine-health generation checks through host-context routineGeneration/state.models to catalog.model.available and ModelV2.Info.make. The same routineGeneration site appears inclusively in 398 of 639 observed samples in profile 1 and 402 of 629 in profile 2. These counts are sample attributions, not CPU or wall-time fractions.
catalog.ts:292 appears inclusively in385/390 samples; projectModel:111 in300/292. The concrete caller chain is retained in the exported critical paths.

Routine health healthy path invokes generationFor four times per candidate (initial, each of two observations, final); three candidates and two context phases imply up to24 model metadata reads per context. This is static path analysis, not a measured call counter.
No performance/product correction is applied in this experiment.
